# load_skill_tool

> Load one of your granted Skills by name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `skills` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=load_skill_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Load one of your granted Skills by name. A Skill bundles how-to instructions,
tools, and reference files. Loading a skill returns its instructions and unlocks
its tools for the rest of the conversation — after loading, call the skill's tools
(named in the response) to do the work.

Workflow:
  1. See the "## Skills" list in your system prompt (name + description of each granted skill).
  2. Call load_skill(name: "<skill-name>") for the relevant skill.
  3. Read the returned instructions, then call the now-activated tools listed in the response.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the skill to load (as shown in your Skills list). |
